subject: Domestic Custody Agreement with Chase
observation: Ghosh asks Shackleton to execute the Chase custody agreement within ten days so securities can be rehypothecated.
qualification: Subject/participants and later seed discussion connect the work; Mahonia is not named in this message.

subject: Rehypothecation of securities
observation: Ghosh estimates roughly $600m cash calls and $42m/year financing cost if Chase securities cannot be passed to Mahonia. He reports AA's linkage concern and asks about contractual permission and default ownership.
qualification: Direct seed. The cash-call estimate is conditional; the AA position is reported by Ghosh, not an independently retrieved auditor response.

subject: Mahonia rehypothecation
observation: Ghosh reports speaking with Shackleton, says Credit approval is required, and asks for review of both Chase and Mahonia documentation and a meeting.
qualification: Explicit Mahonia process continuation; Shackleton's position is reported secondhand here.

subject: Rehypothecation of securities
observation: Ghosh asks Bradford about CRM approval, Treasury-security tenors and operational readiness, and seeks benefits before year-end.
qualification: Reproduces the seed's own text in a quoted region; strong text-supported link. Also records a November 16 forwarding event not recovered as a standalone row.

subject: Re: Rehypothecation of securities
observation: LeBrocq replies that Treasury bills, notes or bonds should be acceptable but may be haircut as necessary.
qualification: Reproduces Ghosh's November 20 text and the seed; supports a response link, not a final haircut schedule or accounting clearance.

subject: Mahonia prepay
observation: Shackleton tells Bushman she will help on the swap piece of the Mahonia prepay.
qualification: Explicit Mahonia subject and shared participants; this short note alone does not prove it concerns the exact same amendment or transaction series.

subject: Rehypothecation of securities
observation: Shackleton offers Ghosh a further discussion and says she is attaching a recap and has collateral annexes in her office.
qualification: Same subject and participants; recap/annexes are not included, so no accounting resolution can be inferred.

subject: Bank of America Credit Support Annexe
observation: In a Bank of America workstream, Ghosh asks Shackleton to coordinate with Bushman to keep Chase and Mahonia contracts consistent.
qualification: Explicit cross-reference supplies related process context; Bank of America is not automatically part of the same Mahonia transaction.

subject: Rehypothecation amendments
observation: Bushman sends Levy clean/marked drafts and asks whether satisfactory so execution can be obtained.
qualification: Related amendment work with the same participants; attachments unavailable.

subject: Rehypothecation amendments
observation: Shackleton forwards Bushman's draft message to Rohauer and Jones, describing it as an example of the Chase CSA amendment and noting longer-dated government securities.
qualification: Reproduces Bushman's own message text. It is not a complete collateral schedule or a final credit approval.

subject: Amendment of Chase/ERMS ISDA dated April 5, 1994
observation: Shackleton asks Levy when the security-agreement amendment permitting rehypothecation will be executed.
qualification: The later reply quotes this request; execution is still being requested.

subject: Re: Amendment of Chase/ERMS ISDA dated April 5, 1994
observation: Shackleton's reply contains Levy's message accepting requested changes to the Enron/Mahonia margin schedule and Enron/Chase ISDA. She proposes exchanging signed originals.
qualification: The acceptance exists as an embedded Levy message. The reply supports planned execution, not independently verified delivery of executed documents.

subject: Amendment of Chase/ERMS ISDA dated April 5, 1994
observation: Shackleton tells Levy ENA is holding the amendment pending Exhibit A describing the collateral and asks for a complete document.
qualification: Quotes her December 18 request. Shows a documentary gap persisted into January 2.

subject: Amendment to Security Agreement to ISDA Agreement between ENAC and Chase
observation: Shackleton says the attachment is correct and asks Panus to return one copy and retain copies for the file, Credit and Ghosh. Embedded Levy requests a fully executed signature page.
qualification: Supports later document handling on the same day. The attachment and executed signature page are unavailable; completion and accounting outcome remain unverified.
